purpose: Single authority for what is CURRENT (V3) versus RETIRED in no3d-tools-website. Documentation, AI-facing files, and support copy must not describe retired behaviour as current. Machine-readable so a check can enforce it.

current.identity: account sign-in with a guest token upgraded to a verified account
current.addonDelivery: device grant via the add-on; no license key entry
current.pricingSourceOfTruth: Stripe Price lookup keys (no3dtools.product.<handle>). Displayed price on V3 product pages is read from /api/commerce/offer, so Stripe is what a visitor is actually charged.

licenseKeyEntry.why: License keys were an artifact of the previous add-on and site version. The current add-on signs the customer in through an account; the account page states 'No license keys or folder setup'.
licenseKeyEntry.doNotConfuse: llms-full.txt also contains ~28 '## License' headings that are COMMERCIAL USE TERMS and remain accurate. Only the key-flow sections are retired.

historicalReferences.issue: instructs visitors to enter and recover a license key
full add-on setup chapter instructing license key entry, plus troubleshooting entries

licenseKeyEntry.referenceStatus: Listed line numbers describe the pre-cleanup snapshot; the current AI-facing files use account access and are guarded by tests.

legacyEndpoints.status: retired, still present in the repository
legacyEndpoints.note: Not linked from any V3 customer route. Retained only while older add-on builds may still call them. Safe to delete once the minimum supported add-on version is past them.

polarIntegration.why: Superseded by Stripe, then by Gumroad parity for legacy members. No customer-facing route references Polar.
polarIntegration.note: Historical operator scripts archived outside the active scripts directory. The retired Polar SDK is not an installed dependency.

legacyWebhook.why: Handles only invoice.paid, invoice.payment_failed, customer.subscription.deleted, customer.subscription.updated. No reconciliation, no one-time product purchase events. Unknown event types are silently ignored.

supersededDocuments.note: Describes the pre-V3 vanilla single-page app.

evidenceNote: A passing test never proves deployment.
